//: What staging holds so the e2e suite has something to sign in to.
THE ADDRESS IS NOT HERE, AND MUST NOT BE. This repo is public and
e2e/CLAUDE.md forbids the test user's address in any committed file — not
as a default, not in a fixture, not in a comment. ${E2E_TEST_USER_EMAIL}
is the same environment secret the Playwright run reads, so the firm and
the sign-in cannot drift onto two different people. Loading fails loudly
if it is unset rather than seeding a firm for the empty string.
The account itself is created once by scripts/e2e-create-test-user.sh;
this only puts it in a firm. Seeding is idempotent and runs on every
staging deploy, so if staging's tables are ever recreated the next run
restores this instead of failing a week later as a mystery app regression.
